# [std](bundle.md)::types

`types` defines foundational types shared by the standard library.

A consumer can repeatedly discard incoming values.

```ruddy
let discard: std::types::Consumer 'a (|) = fn _ => discard
```

## Types

### Consumer

```ruddy
type Consumer 't 'effects = 't -> Consumer 't 'effects + ..'effects
```

A function that repeatedly accepts values and returns itself.

### Never

```ruddy
type Never = |
```

A type with no values.
